scenarios.name: a comment on an item is the commenter's own: nobody can post one in another member's name, and no one else, not even a parent, can edit or delete it

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_donations__items (id, name, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('item1', 'Old bike', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
INSERT INTO app_donations__comments (id, item_id, member_id, kind, body, created_at) VALUES ('cm-kid', 'item1', ?, 'comment', 'Please keep it, I still ride it', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z')
INSERT INTO app_donations__comments (id, item_id, member_id, kind, body, created_at) VALUES ('cm-forged', 'item1', ?, 'comment', 'Fine, keep the bike', '2026-01-02T01:00:00Z')
SELECT id FROM app_donations__comments WHERE member_id = 'scn-parent'

scenarios.name: an item's activity history is attributed to whoever acted and cannot be rewritten or erased by any other member

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_donations__items (id, name, created_by, status, decided_by, decided_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('item1', 'Treadmill', ?, 'let_go', ?, '2026-01-03T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-03T00:00:00Z')
INSERT INTO app_donations__activity (id, item_id, actor_id, action, detail, created_at) VALUES ('act1', 'item1', ?, 'decision', 'let_go', '2026-01-03T00:00:00Z')
SELECT actor_id, action FROM app_donations__activity WHERE item_id = 'item1'
UPDATE app_donations__activity SET detail = 'keep' WHERE id = 'act1'
INSERT INTO app_donations__activity (id, item_id, actor_id, action, detail, created_at) VALUES ('act-forged', 'item1', ?, 'decision', 'keep', '2026-01-04T00:00:00Z')
SELECT id, detail FROM app_donations__activity WHERE actor_id = 'scn-decider'
